title: BCP Capability
description: Schema for BCP capabilities and extensions. Extensions are capabilities with an 'extends' field. Uses reverse-domain naming for governance.
description_pt: Schema para capabilities e extensões BCP. Extensões são capabilities com um campo 'extends'. Usa reverse-domain naming para governança.

extends.description: Parent capability(s) this extends. Present for extensions, absent for root capabilities. Use array for multi-parent extensions.
extends.description_pt: Capability(s) pai que esta estende. Presente para extensões, ausente para capabilities raiz. Use um array para extensões com múltiplos pais.

platform_schema.title: Capability (Platform Schema)
platform_schema.description: Full capability declaration for platform-level discovery. Includes spec/schema URLs for agent fetching.
platform_schema.description_pt: Declaração completa de capability para discovery em nível de plataforma. Inclui URLs de spec/schema para busca pelo agente.

business_schema.title: Capability (Business Schema)
business_schema.description: Capability configuration for business/merchant level. May include business-specific config overrides.
business_schema.description_pt: Configuração de capability em nível de empresa/lojista. Pode incluir sobrescritas de config específicas da empresa.

response_schema.title: Capability (Response Schema)
response_schema.description: Capability reference in responses. Only name/version required to confirm active capabilities.
response_schema.description_pt: Referência de capability em respostas. Apenas name/version são necessários para confirmar as capabilities ativas.
